title: Read recording metadata
description: Reads the frame rate, pixel size and z step from the recording's files (ScanImage, SciScan, ThorImage, Prairie View, TSM, video), as dev's getScanParameters, and writes them into the entity's frame_rate (ophys.imaging), pixel_size_um and z_step_um (ophys.scan) columns. A value the files do not give is left as it is.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the recording, read with a microscope's file adapter.
